integrity: Mathematical proof and exact rational finite verification are supplied; finite checks do not certify arbitrary network extensions or historical priority.
scientific_limitations: Strict pure Nash equilibria of the homogeneous-parameter, zero-prejudice joint public-goods/opinion game on positive-weight complete two-block networks; exact tie surfaces excluded from the full Nash census. No dynamical or empirical conclusions.
title: A five-agent asymmetric community game with exactly three strict Nash equilibria
